thesis.core: AI server, rack and high-speed networking demand continues to support a genuine earnings step-up. 2026H1 revenue and attributable profit reached record levels; the current re-underwrite tests whether the lower completed-session mark now provides enough expected-return margin for incremental capital.
thesis.variant_wedge: The company remains partly valued through a lower-margin EMS lens while AI infrastructure mix is lifting profit faster than revenue. The 2026-09-24 mark has fallen below the prior 15% add hurdle without a disclosed fundamental break in the AI server/rack thesis.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Retain RMB3.15 2026E normalized EPS from the prior decision-grade D2. The fresh review finds no post-H1 primary disclosure requiring a downward reset of normalized earnings.

financial_quality.judgment: The AI earnings inflection remains strong; cash conversion remains the main quality watch because operating cash flow still trails accounting profit.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Retained from the 2026-09-11 fresh D2 after checking current post-H1 disclosure state.

catalysts: Cloud-service-provider AI server revenue and GPU/ASIC rack shipments remain on a high-growth trajectory through H2.
Higher-value AI server and high-speed networking mix sustains profit growth above revenue growth.
Operating cash conversion and free cash flow improve relative to net profit without disproportionate working-capital absorption.
kill_thesis: AI server or rack shipment growth decelerates sharply because customer capex weakens, technology transitions disrupt delivery, or market share is lost.
Gross or net margin reverses despite continued revenue growth, showing the mix upgrade is not durable.
Working capital and capex persistently absorb cash such that free-cash-flow growth materially lags earnings.
Customer concentration, export controls or geopolitical supply-chain disruption materially impair delivery or economics.
